contentList.content: Toggles the chaos engine's random wild encounter groups (wandering patrols) on or off. No action cost.
Toggles the chaos engine's combat reinforcements (extra mobs joining fights) on or off. No action cost.
Currently ENABLED: wild encounter groups (wandering patrols) are spawning. Cast to disable them.
Currently DISABLED: no new wild encounter groups will spawn (existing patrols stay until they expire). Cast to enable them.
Currently ENABLED: combat reinforcements (extra mobs joining fights) are rolling. Cast to disable them.
Currently DISABLED: no extra mobs will join fights. Cast to enable them.
